avis.titre: BEST THING I'VE USED FOR MY SKIN!!
avis.texte: I had flawless skin all throughout my teenage years and early 20's, but have started having issues with acne for the last year or so now that I'm in my mid 20's. It started off with just a pimple here and there and before I knew it, I had a patch on my forehead and my cheeks were covered. I tried many different products and saw little to no results before I switched to this. I started using the three step program about a month ago, and I am AMAZED at the results. I use the cleansing foam 2x a day, the cleansing lotion 2x day, and the benzoyl peroxide step once a day in the morning followed by a moisturizer with sunscreen. At night I do the first two steps and then apply the Clinique 100H hydrator followed with a retinol cream and then a nighttime moisturizer. My skin has never looked better or felt softer than it does right now! My confidence has been boosted so much after using these products, and I plan to continue using them!

I am a Clinique fan. It started when I began getting uneven redness on my cheeks. I typically have great skin, but I still to this day don't know where the redness came from. I used Clinique redness solution line and seen dramatic results. I then transitioned to the smart line to reduce wrinkles and love it! But when I wanted to reduce some breakouts on my chin I decided to grab this since I love their other products. And this caused me to break out even more! I stick with it for about 4 weeks almost 6 thinking maybe the dirt was surfacing and would clear up soon, but no, I began breaking out on my cheeks, even my bf noticed and I mentioned I typically have great clear skin. I had to return and the girl at Ulta suggested Tula skincare like and that had solved my problem. I'm back to clear skin and get compliments pretty often. Tula for acne and still using the smart wrinkle line from Clinique. But this foam wash was a no go for me.

I do get non cystic acne still, but its not nearly as stubborn or painful, and all in all, much less frequently. I highly highly recommend this product and the other products Clinque has for your face needs!

avis.titre: Made my niece's acne much worse
avis.texte: I purchased this cleansing foam by Clinique for my teenager niece, who developed a few pimples on her forehead and cheeks and became self-conscious about it. Before I purchased this cleanser, I read its reviews on beauty websites and it had 4+ stars reviews. I saw my niece a week after she started using the cleanser, and to my horror, her forehead and the cheeks were covered in what seemed to be crusty and inflamed pimples. They almost completely covered her cheeks and a forehead. My sister was very upset and my niece did not want to go out or be seen by anyone...It seemed that this cleanser made my niece's very mild acne 10 times worse. I understand that everyone's skin is different and some may develop an adverse reaction to any type of skincare. So, please beware and follow the instruction carefully.

I used to use proactiv, which worked for my breakouts but left my skin super irritated and extra dry (is in, foundation-looks-like-snake-skin after two hours dry). The Clinique system is just as effective but much less harsh and has absolutely improved my overall skin texture in addition to clearing my acne! ((Give it a full two weeks of twice-daily use--it's not about immediate acne clearing, it's about healing your skin and preventing future breakouts. I'd say I started noticing a substantial acne reduction around day 10)). Absolutely recommend!
